title: CoFlow-5 professor presentation claim ledger
evidence_register_label: 32-row mixed-source evidence register, audited by source type
rules: Literature motivates stakeholder needs; it does not establish CoFlow-5 performance.
Persona statements are design synthesis, not interview quotations.
Decision-matrix numbers and acceptance thresholds are team judgements or proposed targets.
SUMO/HBEFA outputs are emission proxies, not ambient air-quality measurements.
Simulated emergency travel-time effects have no lives-saved interpretation.

claims.safe_wording: The course asks for a working prototype, different traffic conditions, an appropriate baseline comparison, and data-driven strengths and limitations.
The eight personas are research-informed design artifacts and were not validated through stakeholder interviews.
In one New Zealand intersection study, mean perceived pedestrian delay was about twice mean observed delay.
The MUTCD uses 3.5 ft/s (about 1.07 m/s) for pedestrian clearance and calls for slower values where slower users routinely cross.
DfT TAG uses a 0.4 reliability ratio for car/non-freight LGV journey-time variability and a 2x value-of-time multiplier for public-transport waiting.
claims.source: UK Department for Transport, TAG Unit A1.3

claims.safe_wording: In one retrospective Taipei OHCA cohort, each additional ALS-response minute was associated with 7% lower adjusted odds of survival to discharge (aOR 0.93, 95% CI 0.89-0.97).
claims.source: PLOS ONE 2022, 4,278 adult non-traumatic OHCA cases

claims.safe_wording: Nelson and Bullock observed a worst case on the order of 20-30 seconds extra average arterial travel time under closely spaced preemptions in their studied network.
claims.source: Nelson and Bullock, Transportation Research Record 1727

claims.safe_wording: SCATS documentation describes monitoring, manual intervention, and audit trails; this motivates operator control and reason-coded records.
claims.source: Transport for NSW, SCATS Core brochure 2022

claims.safe_wording: For 2005-2006, 6.4 million students (12.5% of the studied US population) attended schools within 250 m of a major roadway.
claims.source: Kingsley et al., Journal of Exposure Science & Environmental Epidemiology

claims.safe_wording: FHWA estimates incidents account for about 25% of congestion, with handbook estimates of 25-30% in many US metropolitan areas.
In RESCO's tested realistic SUMO scenarios, several advanced RL methods were unstable and best-episode reporting differed materially from final performance.
T-REX reports incident-distribution-shift degradation in tested simulation setups; its 1,400 versus 100 episode allocations are not a general cost ratio.
CoLLMLight decouples asynchronous cached cooperative reasoning from faster decisions; CoFlow-5's no-LLM-actuation rule remains an architectural safety choice.
Finkelberg et al. provide a quantified example showing communication impairment can materially change simulated traffic-control outcomes.
claims.source: Finkelberg et al., IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems 2022

claims.safe_wording: The Tunis showcase may use OpenStreetMap geometry and official scheduled TRANSTU GTFS from the Ministry of Transport open-data portal; road demand remains synthetic or calibrated until observed data is sourced.
claims.source: Tunisia Ministry of Transport open-data portal and OpenStreetMap

claims.safe_wording: Transfer sources support mechanisms or measurement methods; they do not establish Tunisian magnitudes. A citation ledger records title, scope, locus status, and transfer limits; remaining from-prior-pack page loci require human verification before submission.
A1 alone writes signals using cooperative Max-Pressure; A2-A5 advise; Synapse never actuates; recovery is Max-Pressure to actuated to fixed-time; DQN is optional.

Rows 07 through 10c are gated evidence slices. On matched seed 37, fixed-time completed 71 of 84 trips, actuated 84 of 84, and cooperative Max-Pressure 70 of 84; the result is mixed and establishes no winner or superiority.
